reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per order, numbered within its customer from the latest
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 3100
    AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 3100
  AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts DESC, order_id) = 1
